examples.translation: The dean has rejected your request.
examples.english: The dean has rejected your request.

examples.text: Ojciec odrzucił ją, gdy odkrył, że nie jest jego córką.
examples.translation: Her father rejected her when he discovered that she's not his daughter.
examples.english: Her father rejected her when he discovered that she's not his daughter.

examples.text: Umarł po tym, jak jego organizm odrzucił przeszczep.
examples.translation: He died after his system rejected the transplant.
examples.english: He died after his system rejected the transplant.

examples.text: Odrzuciliśmy przemoc i protestujemy w sposób pokojowy.
examples.translation: We have disavowed violence and protest in a peaceful way.
examples.english: We have disavowed violence and protest in a peaceful way.

examples.text: Odchodząc od Klima, Dąbrowski odczepił nagle swój granat i rzucił go w kierunku dowódcy. Ten, nie tracąc przytomności umysłu, złapał go i odrzucił z powrotem, na sekundę przed rozerwaniem.
examples.translation: Leaving Klim, Dąbrowski took the granade off his belt and threw it in the direction of the commander. The one, who without stumbling for a second, caught it and threw it back a second after disjecting it.
examples.english: Leaving Klim, Dąbrowski took the granade off his belt and threw it in the direction of the commander. The one, who without stumbling for a second, caught it and threw it back a second after disjecting it.

examples.text: Kiedy otworzyła drzwi, odrzuciła ją odrażająca woń.
examples.translation: When she opened the door, she was taken aback by the horrible smell.
examples.english: When she opened the door, she was taken aback by the horrible smell.

examples.text: Przecież to znakomite gimnazjum, które zapewnia wspaniałe perspektywy! Tyle innych dziewcząt musiałyśmy odrzucić, choć rodzice nas na kolanach błagali..
